cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description: I just updated one of my prototypes to use the latest aspire.hosting and somehow the worker executable isn't in list of running processes. DCP shows me the process: ``` NAME CREATED AT hello 2023-10-17T02:45:15Z proxy 2023-10-17T02:45:15Z uploadservice 2023-10-17T02:45:15Z web 2023-10-17T02:45:15Z worker 2023-10-17T02:45:15Z ```

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix null ref in dashboard when executable doesn't contain endpoints
